items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Him and old Howard was playing at a joint on Iberville Street. I used to go in when I wasn't working.

ctx.x: Just holler. Just holler. Yeah. You thought he was throwing up his lungs. That's right. Just holler. Just his lung was gone.
Playing every night and he drank like a fish. Him and old Howard was playing at a joint on Iberville Street. I used to go in when I wasn't working. That's where I left the office.
